email_body:
Dear Ms. De Geabellich,

I am writing to express my interest in the independent website maintenance consultant role at Pax Christi International. Based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, I am available for up to 10 hours per week during the handover, with flexibility to adjust afterwards.

My background combines hands-on WordPress maintenance with technical SEO and security awareness. At Episto, I manage CMS updates, backups, and plugin maintenance for client sites, including a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles. I have practical experience with hosting, DNS, and coordinating with external providers, and I regularly document technical risks and recommendations. I am discreet, understand data protection responsibilities, and communicate technical issues clearly to non-technical colleagues.

I propose an hourly rate of €45 excluding VAT and can provide examples of similar work upon request.

Thank you for considering my application.

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Ms. De Geabellich,

I am writing to apply for the independent website maintenance consultant position at Pax Christi International. With a technical background in web development and current freelance work in WordPress maintenance and SEO, I am confident in my ability to support the reliability, security, and technical upkeep of your website and infrastructure.

In my current role at Episto, I handle CMS content management, plugin updates, and backups for multiple client websites, including a pharmacists' association site with approximately 600 member profile pages. I have practical experience coordinating with hosting providers, managing DNS records, and implementing security best practices. I also run my own WordPress site and have built and optimized several others, giving me a deep understanding of the technical operations you require.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and available for up to 10 hours per week during the handover period. I am reliable, discreet, and used to documenting technical work and risks clearly for non-technical colleagues. I understand the importance of data protection and always coordinate changes with relevant teams.

I propose an hourly rate of €45 excluding VAT. Examples of similar work are available upon request.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to Pax Christi International's mission.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

• Based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium; fluent in English; available up to 10 hours per week during handover.
